units.intent: Forks, execs, and manages one bedrock server subprocess for tests, and provides the request/response plumbing and direct DB access tests use against it.

objects.name: BedrockTester
objects.role: owns one bedrock server subprocess: starts/stops it, sends it commands over TCP, reads its DB file directly, and tracks all live instances for stopAll

objects.name: BedrockTester::autoAttachDebugger
objects.role: speaks a small JSON-over-socket protocol to an LLDB RPC server to auto-attach a debugger to the spawned process

misfits.why: A self-contained LLDB RPC-socket client with its own wire protocol, unrelated to running a server subprocess and sending it commands
misfits.suggested_home: a standalone debug-attach helper, or null

location_fit.note: Fits; core per-server test harness class.

naming_quality.note: Repo-typical (_-prefixed private members); _commitCountBase vs. the reference member _commitCount is a little confusing on first read but is explained at the constructor.

units.intent: Hands out non-conflicting TCP ports from a fixed range to BedrockTester instances so parallel tests don't collide, recycling returned ports once confirmed free.

objects.name: PortMap
objects.role: allocates ports sequentially from a fixed range, recycles returned ones, and confirms a port is bindable before handing it out

naming_quality.note: Consistent with repo convention (_-prefixed private members); not S-prefixed, but it's test-only infrastructure rather than a libstuff shared utility type.

units.intent: Backs tpunit++'s ASSERT_EQUAL/ASSERT_NOT_EQUAL family, printing both compared values with an = or != between them when an assertion fails.

objects.name: PrintEquality
objects.role: constructor-only helper templated on the two compared types; prints 'a (= or !=) b' to cout when constructed

objects.name: operator<<(ostream&, const map<T,U>&)
objects.role: prints a map as one 'k: v' line per entry

misfits.why: Generic stream-formatting utilities with no dependency on PrintEquality or tpunit, bundled here only because PrintEquality's own printing happens to need them
misfits.suggested_home: a shared stream-formatting utility header in libstuff, or null

name_fit.note: The file does far more than print equality - it defines general-purpose container-printing operators.

location_fit.note: Test-only placement is defensible for the class itself, less so for the generic operator<< overloads it carries.

naming_quality.note: PrintEquality's own name matches its narrow job.

units.intent: A client-side SQLite subclass that forwards every read/write to a BedrockTester's server as a Query command instead of touching a local DB file, so HC-Tree-mode tests can still use SQLite-shaped call sites.

objects.name: RemoteSQLite
objects.role: overrides SQLite's read/write/writeIdempotent family to serialize each call into a Query command sent via the owning BedrockTester

objects.name: RemoteSQLite::_runRemoteQuery
objects.role: builds and sends the Query command with bound parameters as sql-param-<name> headers, shared by all public overrides

location_fit.note: Fits; test-only infrastructure paired with BedrockTester.

naming_quality.note: Consistent with the SQLite base class's naming and repo convention (_-prefixed private member/helper).

units.intent: A minimal SHTTPSManager subclass used by tests to make outbound HTTPS requests and read back their status code, with no product-specific response handling.

objects.name: TestHTTPS
objects.role: trivial SHTTPSManager subclass; exposes sendRequest publicly and parses the response status code out of the raw HTTP method line in _onRecv

location_fit.note: Fits; test-only HTTPS helper alongside the rest of test/lib.

units.intent: Implements the tpunit++ micro test framework's runner: fixture registration, multithreaded execution with name filtering, before/after hooks, pass/fail bookkeeping, and console output.

objects.name: tpunit::_TestFixture
objects.role: fixture base; registers itself on construction and implements the whole run loop, per-class and per-test threading, method dispatch with exception trapping, and float-equality helpers

objects.name: tpunit::_TestFixture::method
objects.role: one registered before/after/test callback; linked-list node

objects.name: tpunit::_TestFixture::stats
objects.role: global pass/fail counters and failure-name set

objects.name: tpunit::Tests::run
objects.role: public entry points that call into _TestFixture::tpunit_detail_do_run

objects.name: tpunit::tpunit_break_check_line
objects.role: keeps short-form dot output readable when a verbose log line interrupts it

name_fit.note: It's the vendored micro-framework's implementation file; the ++ suffix is unusual but recognizable.

location_fit.note: Fits; kept under test/lib with the rest of the test infrastructure.

naming_quality.note: registerTests taking 70 individually numbered method* parameters (m0..m69) is a design wart inherited from the upstream framework, not a naming defect, but it stands out.
